answer:
Set the concurrency to 1. Promptfoo runs evaluations in parallel up to a concurrency limit, so a limit of 1 makes it run one request at a time across all providers and test cases.

**Command line:**

```powershell
promptfoo eval -j 1
```

The long form, `--max-concurrency 1`, should be equivalent.

**Config file:** if you want this to be the default for a project, I believe you can set it under `evaluateOptions` in `promptfooconfig.yaml`:

```yaml
evaluateOptions:
  maxConcurrency: 1
```

I'm not certain of the exact key name in your version, so check `promptfoo eval --help` or the docs for your installed version. If you need to slow requests further, for example to avoid rate limits, I also recall a `delay` option under `evaluateOptions`, but I'm less sure of its details, so verify it before relying on it.
